semantics.scope: Only six formal mixed cells in current local forward/reverse readback; each comparison stays inside its block. All-short, warmups and old hosts/blocks are not combined.
semantics.partition: arrival_to_submission + submission_to_first_schedule + first_schedule_to_first_token + first_token_to_completion = request completion minus arrival
semantics.submission: admission_s is the start of host engine.add_request submission; submission_return_s is retained separately and not counted again.
semantics.first_schedule: First positive scheduled-token record; first_schedule_s is the corresponding host scheduler-call start, not an exact GPU execution timestamp. Actual scheduling is observed within [first_schedule_s, first_schedule_end_s].
semantics.phase_limits: Submission-to-first-schedule includes remaining submission overhead and native queue residence. First-schedule-to-first-token includes chunked prefill, interference, scheduling and host receipt overhead; it is not pure prefill compute. First-token-to-completion includes all decode-period execution and waiting; it is not pure GPU time.
semantics.bypasses: Count later arrival first-admitted before each request in actual result insertion order, including same-step prefix order. Same-step ranking does not imply positive wall-clock delay between those admissions.
semantics.inference_limits: Deltas are matched observed outcomes, not per-request causal effect estimates from a same-state fork. No route-based counterfactual, sum of overlapping request phases as GPU time, cross-host comparison, significance claim or quality claim.
